title: Authority to Pay an Approved ShieldCare Repair Claim
content:
## The occasion

Where a claim stands approved for repair on a covered item under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan,
the plan pays the part of the repairer's bill that the cover carries. The amount the plan pays on the
claim is released only once no premium period covering the day the failure happened stands unpaid on the
plan. The payment is made to the party the decision on the claim named to carry out the work, against the
authorisation number that decision issued for it. The money comes out of the cover still available on the
plan, and the customer sees the settlement on the claim and the reduced cover on the plan.

## Recording the payout

The payout is recorded with `book_claim_payout_542e239c`, a care desk tool that is unlocked and then
called by the agent working the claim. One call books a single payout entry against the named claim on the
named plan, in the form of settlement given, and takes the same amount off the cover still available on
that plan.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | An identifier: the reference number of the ShieldCare protection plan the claim sits on, read from the plan record retrieved for this customer. |
| `claim_reference` | Copied verbatim: the claim reference the retailer issued when the incident was taken, character for character from the claim entry on the plan's history or from what the customer reads out, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion. |
| `covered_item_serial` | Copied verbatim: the serial number of the covered item the claim concerns, character for character from the plan record or from what the customer reads off the item, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion. |
| `payout_amount` | A fixed-format money amount: what the plan is paying on this settlement, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the cent when a longer figure is passed. There is no empty value. |
| `settlement_basis` | An enumerated value: the form this settlement takes, one of `repair`, the item put right and the repair paid for; `replacement`, a replacement item provided in place of the failed one; `reimbursement`, money paid to the customer instead of goods or work; `buyout`, the plan bought out and closed by a single payment; `no_settlement`, the claim closed with nothing paid on it. |
| `payment_method` | An enumerated value: how the money goes out, one of `card_on_file`, `store_credit`, `bank_transfer`, `in_store_cash` or `business_invoice` — respectively a credit to the card held on the profile, store credit posted on the profile, money sent to the customer's bank account, money handed over at a branch counter, or an amount credited on the invoice account a business profile settles on terms. |
| `service_provider` | An enumerated value: who carries out or carried out the work this payment settles, one of `in_store_bench`, a bench technician at one of the retailer's own stores; `authorized_depot`, a repair depot the retailer authorises to take the item in; `on_site_technician`, a technician attending the address where the item stands; `partner_network`, an independent repairer in the retailer's partner network; `customer_arranged`, a repairer the customer found and engaged themselves. |
| `repair_authorization_number` | Copied verbatim: the authorisation number issued to the repairer for this claim, character for character from the adjudication entry on the plan's history, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion. |

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, naming the reference of the new payout entry, a string
beginning pcp_, the claim and plan it was booked against, the amount paid in USD to two decimal places,
the repairer the payment is made to, the authorisation number it is made against, and the cover still
remaining on the plan in USD to two decimal places. A sentence beginning "Claim payout booked" means the
money was paid and the plan's remaining cover was reduced.
